observations: White sewing machine with a handle on top.
Brand 'TOYOTA' is visible in red text on the side in both photos.
Blue control panel with stitch selection and a large white dial.
The machine appears to be a tabletop model with a flat base.
There is visible wear and dirt on the surface, especially around the base and edges.
No power cord or motor is visible in either photo.
The machine is placed on a dark, possibly concrete or tiled floor.
Background shows a metal rack and some clutter, suggesting a workshop or storage area.

claims.evidence: The machine is shown in a used condition with visible wear, consistent with being preloved.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The motor or power cord may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: Photo of the power cord and motor, or a video showing the machine running with power.
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing motor or cord

risks.risk: The machine may have hidden mechanical issues or wear not visible in photos.

Video of the machine powered on and stitching fabric.
Photo of the power cord and motor.
Close-up video of the needle and bobbin area in motion.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
